title: Family Meal at Kitchen Table, 1966 Vintage B&W Snapshot
description: A candid mid-1960s family gathering in a home kitchen, captured around a small table covered with a lace tablecloth. A young woman with a prominent 1960s bouffant hairstyle smiles toward the camera on the left, while other family members, including an elder relative and a young child, share a meal together. The photo margin is stamped 'MAY 66'.
